description: Infrastructure parameters applied on top of the per-token IT energy. Each is a {low, mid, high} triple (equal values = a point value). Override any of them in the project config (.claude/pegada.config.json) with a number or a triple. See METHODOLOGY.md §4.3.

pue.source: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2026, capacity-weighted average annual PUE (1.36; Uptime Intelligence, 'The growing PUE advantage of larger data centers', 6 Aug 2026). The per-facility average is 1.52.
pue.notes: Consequential framing: running on an efficient hyperscale facility displaces other load onto the average facility, so the capacity-weighted industry average is used instead of the provider's own PUE (EcoLogits uses 1.09–1.14 for Anthropic). Point value by design.

grid_intensity.source: mid = EcoLogits 0.11.1 electricity mix for the USA (0.3844 kgCO2e/kWh). low/high: indicative spread between low-carbon (hydro/nuclear-heavy) and coal-heavy grids, not taken from a dataset.
grid_intensity.notes: The serving region is unknown (transcripts report inference_geo = not_available). Location-based: renewable energy certificates and PPAs are not credited.

embodied.unit: gCO2e per kWh of IT energy
embodied.source: Envelope of the per-family factors derived from EcoLogits 0.11.1 (H100 GPU and server manufacturing GWP, 3-year lifetime, time-allocated). calibration/derive_coefficients.py.
embodied.notes: Model families carry their own embodied factor; this value applies only to a family without one. Setting 'embodied' in the project config overrides every family.
